pattern: に至る / に至った（にいたる / にいたった）
aliases: にいたる / にいたった
purpose: Mark arrival at a consequential stage or outcome.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
V dictionary / N + に至る / に至った
After long discussions, we reached an agreement.
He described the circumstances that led him to resign.
A small misunderstanding led to a court case.
formation: V dictionary / N + に至る / に至った
restrictions: Often describes a process culminating in a decision or event.
mistake: It need not imply a welcome achievement.
